title: Pi AGENTS.md grill workflow with four taste skills and /handoff at 100k
summary: Personal Pi workflow loads ponytail, grilling, wayfinder, and ask-matt via AGENTS.md, forces a long interrogation pass, then uses a custom /handoff extension at 100k tokens to continue across sessions.
question_it_answers: How do you preserve human taste decisions across long Pi coding sessions?

claims.text: AGENTS.md auto-loads four skills and the agent grills the human across roughly a hundred questions before building.
claims.evidence:
AGENTS.md auto loads up these 4 skills:
ponytail
grilling
wayfinder
ask-matt
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: A custom /handoff Pi extension writes a continuation document when context reaches 100k tokens.
claims.evidence: I have a custom Pi extension called /handoff that when the context window reaches 100k it asks the model to produce a handoff document
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops
